ledger.x: 1918, February-March: the I Polish Corps holds six Belarusian districts.
1918, 2 February: the siege of the Babruysk fortress begins.
1918, 11 March: the Babruysk fortress falls ('the fortress fell on 11 March, but the German army forced the Polish forces to give over the fortress').

wars.name: I Polish Corps in Russia: refusal to disband and the Babruysk operations
wars.outcome: The corps refused the Soviet disbandment order on 25 January 1918, fought around Babruysk from 2 February, joined the German offensive of 18 February (Minsk on 21 February), held six districts from 28 February and was disarmed by the Germans after the…

certainty.note: A military occupation of districts; no treaty or survey line; the page names the triangle by three towns.
